title: Web Developer And SEO Executive
job_description:
Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Entry-level position; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Proficiency in web development frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js. Solid understanding of responsive design principles and implementation. Experience with keyword research and SEO best practices. Familiarity with on-page and off-page optimization techniques. Ability to conduct website audits and identify areas for improvement. Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Bahasa Malaysia. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and trends.

Conduct keyword research and analysis to identify relevant and high-traffic keywords for SEO optimization. Implement on-page SEO strategies, including optimizing website content, meta descriptions, and title tags. Build high-quality backlinks through outreach and content promotion to improve website authority and search engine rankings. Monitor and analyze website traffic, keyword rankings, and other SEO metrics using tools like Google Analytics and Google Search Console. Develop and maintain responsive website designs using web development frameworks to ensure optimal user experience across all devices. Collaborate with the marketing team to create SEO-friendly content for blog posts, articles, and other marketing materials. Stay up-to-date with the latest SEO trends and algorithm updates to ensure website optimization strategies are effective. Perform technical SEO audits to identify and fix website issues that may be affecting search engine rankings. Manage and optimize Google My Business listings to improve local search visibility. Assist in the development and execution of SEO strategies to increase organic traffic and improve search engine rankings for the company website. Create websites based on the market research
